evidence.quote: We invest in our employees through a suite of programs from their first day of employment to develop their talent and skills as our business grows.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Structured sales and product training for new customer care and success staff, plus live and online technical training and tech talks
evidence.quote: Our technical teams have access to live and online training resources and participate in frequent company tech talks where training on best practices and latest developments are shared.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Holds a VPAT 508 (Section 508 accessibility conformance documentation) as part of its U.S. government compliance portfolio
evidence.quote: We also hold CMMC Level 2 certification, ITAR, FIPS, CJIS, SOC 1 and VPAT 508 in our U.S. Government portfolio.

cross_cultural.criterion: level 1: listed compliance credential only, with no described accessibility feature or program

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers cloud cybersecurity products in detail and shows no creative work being created, enabled or supported. Uses of 'design' refer to engineering and do not count.

community.reason: Level 2: the filing describes only employee development programs, with no external education or community investment, so the score is capped at 2.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1: the Human Capital section is substantial but describes no inclusion activity, and the only related item is a VPAT 508 listed among compliance credentials with no described accessibility feature or program, so it scores at most 1 when torn. International operations do not count.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: this rests on general language only, namely the company's own innovation and R&D and an 'Innovation' value, and the filing has no specific service enabling founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: The Item 7 (targeted) excerpt was empty, so no MD&A paragraphs matched the theme terms. The channel partner 'education, training and programs' supports resellers and integrators in selling Zscaler products. That is commercial sales enablement, not external education or small-business enablement, so it was not scored. The Zenith Live conference and Public Sector Summit are marketing events and were not scored. 'Foundation' (security architecture), 'content' (web content), 'training' (AI/ML model training) and 'identity' (identity-based access) are trap terms and were excluded. Customers are mostly large enterprises ('enterprises of all sizes'), with no small-business program. The Human Capital section describes no community investment, volunteering, employee networks or inclusion programs. Coverage is still marked sufficient because the section is well over 150 words and does not point to another document for these areas.
